description.p: Nib is a small markdown editor that formats what you write as you write it. There is no split screen and no preview pane: headings, emphasis, lists, tables, code and math take their final shape in the same window you type in, and the markdown underneath stays plain text you can open anywhere.

ul.li: Realtime inline preview, so the document always looks the way it will read
Notes that sync across your devices
An MCP server, so a language model can read and write your notes with your permission
Paste images straight from the clipboard
Publish a file as a page on the web, with a custom domain if you have one

description.p: Nib is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License. The same editor also runs in a browser at nibeditor.com.
